Watch: Keep an eye on oil prices and any further escalation in the Middle East, as this can impact broader market sentiment.
Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and watching for any signs of broader market weakness.
plays: Trim SMH if it breaks below 540.
Trim QQQI if it breaks below 52.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
